description: This file contains functions related to downloading a browser with progress indication, including handling retries, progress display, and inter-process communication for download management within the Playwright project.

methods.name: downloadBrowserWithProgressBar
methods.description: Downloads a browser with a progress bar, handling retries and cleanup.

methods.name: downloadBrowserWithProgressBarOutOfProcess
methods.description: Performs the download in a separate process, monitors progress, and verifies completion.

methods.name: logPolitely
methods.description: Logs messages to the console unless the log level suppresses output.

methods.name: getDownloadProgress
methods.description: Selects the appropriate progress display function based on TTY availability.

methods.name: getAnimatedDownloadProgress
methods.description: Provides animated progress bar updates for TTY environments.

methods.name: getBasicDownloadProgress
methods.description: Provides simple textual progress updates for non-TTY environments.

methods.name: toMegabytes
methods.description: Converts bytes to a human-readable megabytes string.
